snippet.title: Wrap The Zap - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Immerse yourself in a vibrant, sci-fi puzzle world of light and logic. Welcome to Wrap The Zap!
Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.rikzu.wrap.the.zap
App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/wrap-the-zap/id6754759687

Your goal is to skillfully wrap glowing electrical lines around spherical conduits. Connect them all correctly to bring a stunning hexagonal grid to life and power up the level!

◆ INTUITIVE & PRECISE GAMEPLAY ◆
With controls designed for touch, simply guide the tip of each electrical rope with your finger. The smooth, flowing movement makes solving puzzles incredibly satisfying.

◆ A PUZZLE THAT EVOLVES ◆
What starts as a simple task soon becomes a delightful web of complexity. 

You'll need to master new mechanics to solve the grid:
● Match the Colors: Each neon line must connect to its corresponding colored conduit.
● Don't Cross the Streams: Lines cannot intersect themselves or other lines, or you'll lose your connection!
● Master the Pins: Use static and movable pins to bend your lines around obstacles and navigate tricky paths.

◆ RELAX & SOLVE AT YOUR OWN PACE ◆
This is a game about focus and flow, not stress.
● No Timers, No Pressure: Take all the time you need to find a solution. There's no way to lose.
● Creative Freedom: Many puzzles have multiple solutions. Find your own unique path to victory.
● Soothing Atmosphere: Lose yourself in the cool, neon visuals and a chill, ambient soundtrack designed to help you relax and focus.

◆ MORE FEATURES ◆
● Two Unique Sectors: Explore Sector Alpha and Beta, each with its own distinct color palette and challenges.
● Collectable Stars: Earn up to three stars per level by completing the puzzle and collecting them from the board.
● Helpful Hints: Feeling stuck? Use hints to reveal the optimal path or the correct placement for pins.
● Colorblind Accessibility: An option that adds unique shapes to each color ensures everyone can enjoy the puzzle.
● Daily Quests & Non-Linear Map: Choose your own path and log in for new challenges and rewards.

Are you ready to untangle the lines and light it up? Download Wrap The Zap now and find your flow
